newsitem.title: USA: Apartment Investment management buys shares.
newsitem.headline: Apartment Investment management buys shares.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said Tuesday that eight members of senior management purchased 379,750 newly issued shares of the company's Class A common stock on October 1 at a price of $20.75 per share, that day's closing price on the New York Stock Exchange.
In payment for the stock, the company said management executed notes payable to the company, bearing interest at 7.25 percent per annum, payable quarterly, and due in 2006.
The stock purchase notes are secured by the shares purchased and are of recourse as to 25 percent of the principal owed.
In addition, the company said, members of management agreed to purchase an additional 500,000 shares on similar terms prior to January 31, 1997.
Upon completion of these transactions, the company said officers and directors will own about 13 percent of the company's outstanding common stock and OP Units.
